feed_title: Orthopaedic Memory Foam Dog Bed in Corduroy with Bolsters, Small 45 x 29.5cm to Large 83 x 66cm, Beige Grey or Green | PawLunova Kendal
descriptionHtml:
Corduroy. Memory foam. A bed nobody pushes behind a chair.

Kendal is a memory foam orthopaedic dog bed in corduroy, in Small 45 × 29.5cm, Medium 61 × 44cm and Large 83 × 66cm. Cushioned bolsters in Beige, Grey or Green.

Count the dog beds in your house that live behind a chair. Most homes have one. It went there because it was grey nylon with a logo on the front and did not suit the room. The dog followed, used it twice, and came back to your feet.

Corduroy is furniture fabric. It sits beside the sofa without looking like equipment, so the bed stays where the company is.

What they get

  • A memory foam core: Foam that holds its shape, not filling that packs into ridges.
  • Bolsters to rest a chin on: Cushioned sides for a dog who settles by pressing into them.
  • Corduroy you want to touch: A ribbed cover in Beige, Grey or Green.
  • A 30°C wash: The cover comes off and goes in the machine, per its care label.

Best for: Small and medium dogs in rooms where you would rather not hide the bed. Chatsworth covers those dogs for less.

Why it is worth the money

This is the most expensive bed we sell for a small dog, so here is the honest case. The foam core has a 5-year no-flatten guarantee under normal domestic use. The cover is furniture fabric, not coated nylon. Across 1825 nights, the five years it runs, the £139 Small is about 8p a night, the £209 Large about 11p.

You have 100 nights. If they ignore it, send it back, we pay the collection and you are refunded.

Watch the Small. It is 45 × 29.5cm outside, bolsters included, sized for a dog curled rather than a spaniel stretched out.

Size and fit

SizeOutside (cm)
Small45 × 29.5
Medium61 × 44
Large83 × 66

Colours: Beige, Grey, Green.

The bolsters sit inside these figures, so measure your dog curled and size up between sizes. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one fits.

Everyday care

Unzip the cover and wash at 30°C following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide. 5 years on the foam.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. The foam core also has a 5-year no-flatten guarantee under normal domestic use, subject to the guarantee terms; cover wear and pet damage are not included. Read the full returns and guarantee terms. This guarantee is in addition to your statutory rights and does not affect them.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

The questions we get asked most.

Which size fits a small dog?

Measure them curled, then compare with the table above.

How quickly does it come?

Free above £40, with the estimate at the basket.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. The checkout lists whatever plans are available.

Does the colour change anything?

No. All three are the same bed at the same price.

Is it sensible for a dog getting on?

Memory foam, bolsters, a 30°C cover. Ask your vet.

Can I actually wash it?

Yes. The cover unzips and takes a 30°C machine wash.

Suppose they never lie on it?

You have 100 nights. We collect and refund in full.

Pick the size they curl into and the colour you can live with.
